test_policy.notes: No Harm Test-Optional for fall entry: applicants choose whether to supply scores; scores are used only if they strengthen the application. Required for the BA/BS+MD and BS+OD Early Assurance programs. Choosing test-optional does not affect aid or merit scholarships.

requirements.notes: One counselor recommendation required (BA/BS+MD: counselor plus a science teacher). Essay of 250-650 words via Common App or Coalition. Portfolio required for some Westphal programs. CSS Profile required for institutional need-based aid (international applicants too); FAFSA also for US citizens and permanent residents. Dates below are applied to the fall 2027 cycle; the deadline page gives month/day and notes a 2026-2027 CSS Profile only for winter entry.

deadlines.label: Early Decision
deadlines.notes: Binding. Decisions released in mid-December (no exact date). Tuition and housing deposit due Jan 15. CSS Profile due Nov 25.

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. Decisions mid-December. Deposit May 1. CSS Profile due Nov 25.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decisions released by April 1. CSS Profile and FAFSA priority due Feb 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt if English is your first language, you have 3 full years of high school instruction in English, SAT EBRW 600+ or ACT English 27+. Highest section scores across dates are used. Drexel's International Gateway program offers conditional admission with English preparation.

english.notes: No numeric minimum published on the testing policy page (TOEFL Essentials also accepted).
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency. No numeric minimum published.

aid.notes: Drexel offers need-based aid to qualifying international students (CSS Profile required by the deadline). Merit scholarship details for international students were not confirmed on the pages opened.

tier_notes.arts_design: Westphal College of Media Arts & Design (film, design, games) is nationally known.
